COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
CRLR No.566 of 2024
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Ms. Suraiya Naaz, Advocate for the 
revisionists.
 Mr. Virendra Singh Rawat, AGA for 
the State/respondent no.1. 
 The challenge in this revision is 
made to the order dated 29.06.2024, 
passed by the learned Judge, Family 
Court, Khatima, District Udham Singh 
Nagar in Misc. Criminal Case No.121 of 
2020, Smt. Sandeep Kaur Vs. Karamjeet 
Singh, under Section 125 of the Code of 
Criminal Procedure, 1973 (“the Code”). 
By it, the revisionists have been granted 
`6,000/- per month as interim 
maintenance under Section 125 of the 
Code. 
 Heard.
 It is argued that the amount of that 
the amount of maintenance is 
inadequate.
 Admit.
 Issue notice to the respondent no.2, 
returnable within six weeks. Steps to be 
taken within a week.
 Call for the LCR.
 List on 04.11.2024.
 
 
(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 14.08.2024
Sanjay

COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
CRLR No.566 of 2024
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Ms. Anmol Sandhu, Advocate holding 
brief of Mr. Lalit Sharma, Advocate for the 
revisionists.
 Mr. Virendra Singh Rawat, AGA for the 
State. 
 Mr. Harshpal Sekhon, Advocate for 
respondent no.2.
 As soon as the matter is taken up, 
learned counsel for the respondent no.2 
would submit that it is a matrimonial 
discord. He would submit that if genuine 
efforts are made, perhaps parties may stay 
together. He would also submit that the 
respondent no.2 is working in the Indian 
Navy. He would be on leave from 10th to 
15th December, 2024.
 List on 11.12.2024, just after fresh 
cases, as a first case. 
 On that date, the revisionist no.1 and 
the respondent no.2 shall remain 
personally present so as to explore the 
possibility of amicable settlement between 
the parties.
 
 
(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 04.11.2024
Sanjay
